thread:
ben: Heads-up, deployed gateway header-normalizer to staging ~5m ago. Seeing SDKs drop unknown headers during proxying.
anna: Which headers exactly? route-policy, quota-id?
carlos: x-rd-route-policy and x-rd-quota-id. Go client proxy was the culprit, it normalizes casing and our sanitizer dropped them.
maggie: Ah that's why console route telemetry looked off this morning :grimacing:
ben: Example request on staging:
```http
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.staging.redwood.ai
x-rd-route-policy: tenant=acme;prio=low
x-rd-quota-id: q-12345
Authorization: Bearer ...
```
ben: After reverse proxy it became `X-Rd-Route-Policy` and the SDK header filter returned empty.
lina: Any customer impact? Product flagged a small internal org spike in 5xxs.
carlos: No external reports, but multi-tenant smoke tests failed.
anna: Short-term: SDKs should accept headers case-insensitively and preserve unknown prefixed headers.
maggie: Console ingestion should coalesce variants (lower/upper/canonical) for now.
ben: Proposed quick plan:
- platform: canonicalize headers before rewrite (safe hotfix)
- SDKs: add opt-in preserve-case toggle behind env var
- console: tolerant mapping for 7 days
carlos: I'll draft a tiny Go SDK PR with header-preserve toggle (default on for next patch). Snippet:
```go
for k, v := range orig.Header {
  req.Header[strings.ToLower(k)] = v // preserve lowercase mapping
}
```
anna: Py/TS can do the same; we'll gate behind REDWOOD_PRESERVE_HEADERS=true. Add tests for mixed-case variants.
lina: Product wants minimal risk: env var + staging rollout + canary to two orgs.
maggie: On console I'll add an ingestion rule to emit both canonical and raw header keys in events so we can reconcile.
ben: Timeline: Carlos PR today; Anna + Maggie coordinate SDK + console patches; I'll patch gateway canonicalizer and monitor. Target hotfix window tomorrow AM.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: platform/gateway canonicalizer -> staging. Runbook: monitor /ingest/route-metrics for >3x baseline.
carlos: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/321 (draft)
anna: I'll open py/ts PRs after lunch. Tests included.
lina: Thanks. Keep ops in loop if any external traffic hits staging. :thumbsup:
ben: Will post update in #incidents if anything unusual. Closing loop later today.
